issues.title: Five diagnosis protocol trials not run: no qualified alternative local model
issues.what: The 20x5 protocol ran 95/100 trials (95 correct, 0 failures). The 5 'qualified-local-alternative' trials need a second, independently qualified local diagnosis model; none exists on Omniverse2 (qwen3.8:27b failed the single-response diagnosis; it was not tried stepwise).
issues.impact: If the only qualified diagnosis model fails or is withdrawn, there is no qualified local fallback; recovery then closes BLOCKED for a human.
issues.human_action: Decide whether a second local model is qualified (stepwise) for diagnosis, or accept single-model diagnosis. Owner 2026-10-26: 95/100 accepted.

issues.title: Token usage UNKNOWN for 23 of 95 protocol trials
issues.what: The native path did not report usage for 23 trials; the ledger keeps them as UNKNOWN (never as zero).
issues.impact: Mission budgets for those requests are reconciled conservatively; cost per trial is not exact.
issues.human_action: Decide whether exact usage is required (adapter change) or the conservative UNKNOWN handling is acceptable.

issues.title: Stepwise inspector: clean held-out baselines still falsely rejected
issues.what: Re-measured 2026-10-27 at 9300475 after learning sets 1-3 passed live (49/49, 63/63, 14/14): on the refreshed held-out test set 2 (Feature 015 GPIOA and CRC, registered 48207f1), 3 identical runs: 12/12 seeded defects flagged (11 on target, 1 off target, 0 missed), but 2/2 clean baselines falsely rejected, so the seeded-case detections partly ride on baseline noise (10/12 add a finding code their clean baseline lacks). GPIOA: a model error on the effects step (the BSRR toggle write answered 'not_stated'). CRC: rule gaps the truthful preflight already shows (CRC_CR.REV_IN/RTYPE_IN/REV_OUT/RTYPE_OUT and CRC_DR.DR writes not matched to their requirements; the Budgets gap row not recognised). Earlier subset calibration (285d21e): 49/54 caught, 5/9 clean baselines rejected. Learning set 4 (the spent pair, rules e0c020d) then reached 13/14 with both clean baselines accepted (job 040, learning data only); development is frozen by the owner until >= 4 new frozen held-out baselines exist.
issues.impact: On unseen drivers the advisory inspector registers false gaps for the end-of-run human review (advisory mode: it does not block). Detection carries over; clean-baseline acceptance does not yet.
issues.human_action: Test set 2 is now spent (it may become learning set 4). Release another frozen batch of current-factory baselines (e.g. after the TIM review or new Feature 015 drivers) so a refreshed held-out set can measure further fixes.

issues.what: Every gap's attempt record lists rework, progress extension, validated lessons, diagnosis repair (AFO) and stall detection. CAPA retrieval is not a rung yet. Resolved 2026-10-26 (5f6d540): capa_retrieval rung records the linked CAPAs.

issues.title: No usable parallel model serving for the inspector
